normal.caption_source: edit Computed tomography of the head, without intravenous contrast, here presented in the axial plane with 4 mm slice thickness. It shows normal anatomy, with no injuries. The subject is an 18 year old male who had blunt trauma to the head after a 25 m long jump during motocross.
